name: Rawa Island Beach
evidenceNote: Provider identifies an uninhabited Rawa island northwest of the Perhentian islands, Terengganu, South China Sea. The public Google Maps embed resolves a named entity Rawa Island Beach, South China Sea (0x31b6ddb329eb8df7:0x1497a0c1b546d923), CID 1483831356072319267, at these marker coordinates. Its position matches the Perhentian Rawa, not the Johor Rawa resort. Coordinates are the named beach marker, not a map viewport or island centre.

name: Kuala Terengganu Beach
evidenceNote: Provider record 458201228 identifies Redang Island, Terengganu, 49 km from Kuala Terengganu and 25 km from Merang. Its description explicitly calls this a lively marine park with white sand and a jetty; reviews call it marine park beach. Google Maps public categorical search for Redang Marine Park returns a beach feature, CID 13820125668680823945. Resolving that CID returns the actual named Marine Park, 21090, Terengganu marker at these coordinates (0x31b70fe3286323a5:0xbfcaf312d0fa7489). The separate park-centre CID 8930558808186632655 and mainland Batu Buruk beach are excluded. This identifies the marine park shoreline within the Redang island group, not Kuala Terengganu city.
area: Marine Park beach, Redang Islands, Terengganu

name: Romantic Beach
evidenceNote: Provider identifies a 70 m bay beach on Perhentian Besar, 380 m from Turtle Beach. Resolving Google Maps CID 3752994826308369234 returns the actual entity Romantic Beach, Pulau Perhentian Besar, Terengganu with these marker coordinates. CID 8505484290012914078 instead resolves Romantic Beach, Pulau Perhentian Kecil, Besut, Terengganu at 5.9230838,102.7170936 and is excluded. Coordinates are the matching Besar beach marker, not a viewport.

name: Turtle Beach
evidenceNote: CSV rows 4 and 68 both contain only Turtle Beach. Provider has Perhentian Besar record 458201237 and Bintulu/Sarawak record 458201273. No provider id or locality in the CSV establishes which row maps to which record. The linked Besar record is a candidate, not a verified row identity; region and coordinates remain null.

name: Pulau Sembilang
evidenceNote: Provider identifies Sembilang Island in Johor, South China Sea, with a 90 m beach. JUPEM identifies Pulau Sembilang in Rompin/Pahang at 2.691111,103.885909; those are island coordinates and the administrative attribution conflicts. A sailing guide describes a western beach but only publishes offshore anchorage coordinates. Neither is accepted as the beach location.

name: Usukan Island Beach
evidenceNote: Provider identifies Usukan Island Beach near Kota Belud, Sabah, South China Sea, boat access only, 3 km from Usukan Cove Beach. Dolphin Bay Island Resort official website (https://dolphinbayislandresort.com/home) explicitly identifies Pulau Usukan, a white sandy bay beach and a ten-minute boat trip from Usukan Cove. Resolving Google Maps CID 9993617960790048814 returns Dolphin Bay Island Resort, Pulau Usukan, 89150 Kota Belud, Sabah at these actual marker coordinates. This is an approximate beachfront property reference for the matching island beach, not a measured beach boundary; the mainland Usukan Cove marker is excluded.

area: Penang National Park, Penang Island, Penang

name: Pasir Panjang
evidenceNote: Exact provider title Pasir Panjang, record 458201218, identifies Kapas Island, Terengganu, 18 km from Kuala Terengganu. JUPEM record 2350, class Pantai, lists Psr. Panjang in Marang at these coordinates on Kapas; GeoNames beach 7608763 independently gives 5.2275,103.2636. Do not substitute Redang, Penang or Perak beaches of the same name.

name: Chagar Hutang Beach
sourceName: Indian Ocean Turtle Newsletter / Chagar Hutang sanctuary researcher
evidenceNote: Provider identifies Chagar Hutang Beach on northern Redang Island, Terengganu. The sanctuary researcher's IOTN July 2010 paper explicitly locates the 350 m nesting beach at 5 degrees 48.778 minutes N, 103 degrees 0.502 minutes E; decimal conversion gives these coordinates. OpenStreetMap-based Beach World Map lists Pasir Chagar Hutang at 5.8129,103.0083.

name: Cherita Cave Beach
evidenceNote: Provider identifies Cherita Cave Beach on Langkawi, Kedah, Strait of Malacca, 180 m of sand at Gua Cherita. JUPEM lists the cave point 6.466310,99.843107, but does not identify a beach point; cave coordinates are withheld from beach latitude/longitude. Google Maps resolves Gua Cherita, Langkawi, Kedah at 6.4672028,99.846554 (CID 6748239255500011577); this is a cave feature rather than a named beach marker. The park manager and Langkawi tourism describe access via a beach and steps, but do not establish which part of the 180 m beach the cave marker represents, so it is not substituted as a beach coordinate.

evidenceNote: Provider identifies Pulau Kukus beach on Kukus Island, Johor, South China Sea, 6.3 km from Pulau Lima Besar and 6.7 km from Sea Gypsy Resort beach.
